sn4.10:1.2: The Bamboo Grove was a major monastery near Rājagaha. According to [pli-tv-kd1:22.16.1](), it was offered by King Bimbisāra as the very first monastery dedicated to the Saṅgha.
sn4.10:2.4: A hundred years was the standard long life (eg. [snp3.8:16.1](), [dn14:3.30.5](), [an7.74:10.3]()).
sn4.10:4.4: This echoes the idea that a wheeled chariot was unstoppable ([sn56.11:12.2]()), an idea arising from the Vedic conception of the Sun as a wheel.
